help.title: How to connect the scanner
help.intro: The scanner is a Bluetooth device that pairs through your phone's Bluetooth settings — like a headset. Once paired, it sends scanned barcodes straight into the app.
help.step1: Turn on the scanner and put it in pairing mode (usually by holding the power button until its light blinks).
help.step3: In the list of available devices, tap the scanner to pair it. It often appears with a name like "Barcode Scanner", "BarCode", "SPP", or the model number.
help.step4: Come back to this app and start scanning — barcodes will be entered automatically.
help.name_hint: Not sure which device is yours? Check the scanner's manual or the label on its underside for its exact Bluetooth name.

subscriptions.ad_banner_body: No interruptions while you work — Free, Professional or Business. Same price on phone or tablet. 1 branch included.

subscriptions.faq_q0: What's the difference between Professional and Business?
subscriptions.faq_a0: Choose Professional for a single shop: up to 1,000 products, Excel / CSV, up to 3 team members, Bluetooth scanner support and our full 500M+ product database. Choose Business for a mid-to-large store: unlimited products, unlimited team members and unlimited AI expiry + lot scanning for much faster data entry.
subscriptions.faq_a1: Yes — cancel whenever you want. No contracts, no penalties, no questions asked.
subscriptions.faq_a2: No. Team members are included in your one subscription — 3 on Professional, unlimited on Business.
subscriptions.faq_q3: What happens to my data if I downgrade?
subscriptions.faq_a3: Nothing is ever deleted. Back on Free, all your products stay safe and visible — even above 20. You just cannot add new ones until you are under 20 or upgrade again.
